CustomField.description: Generic approval gate used by ApprovalGenericStatusHandler.runFromGenericStatus. Set to Pending on submit; Approved/Rejected by the standard approval Final Actions. A record-triggered flow watching this field calls the invocable to run the configured on-submit/on-approval/on-rejection actions for whichever Approval Configuration is currently active (identified by Approval_Name__c).
CustomField.label: Approval Status
